replies.text:
​​@cmack17for sure and I guess I should clarify... I have an utter disdain for basically anything made after 2010. 

Prices skyrocketed beyond belief.. I bought my first Toyota in like 2005 for 17,000 lol. 

That car is still driving in my family today with over 300,000 miles. 

I get what youre saying and perhaps I'm saying it wrong but the insane prices we see on vehicles made in the past 18 years or so on top of the obvious quality declines and some obvious planned obsolescence is what makes me stay away from any of those vehicles.

I get the reality that cars are always depreciating but a vehicle that has an arbitrarily inflated price basically immediately depreciates that overvalue on top of normal depreciation. 

Hopefully that's a better way of explaining my position. Definitely some of my verbiage could have been better.
